commands.exportExcalidraw: Export note highlights to Excalidraw mindmap

showTitles.name: Show note titles in all notes and collections
showTitles.desc: Display the filename/note title below highlights when viewing All Notes or Collections.

showActions.name: Show highlight actions
showActions.desc: Display the actions area below each highlight (filename, stats, and buttons).

showToolbar.name: Show toolbar
showToolbar.desc: Display the toolbar with search, grouping, and other action buttons.

autoUnfold.name: Auto-unfold on focus
autoUnfold.desc: Automatically unfold content when focusing highlights from the sidebar.

dateFormat.name: Date format
dateFormat.desc: Format string for timestamps using moment.js syntax (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm, MMM DD YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY h:mm A).

minimumCharCount.name: Minimum character count
minimumCharCount.desc: Hide highlights and native comments shorter than this character count from the sidebar (default 0).

showCurrentNoteTab.name: Show Current Note tab
showCurrentNoteTab.desc: Show the Current Note tab in the sidebar.

showAllNotesTab.name: Show All Notes tab
showAllNotesTab.desc: Show the All Notes tab in the sidebar.

showCollectionsTab.name: Show Collections tab
showCollectionsTab.desc: Show the Collections tab in the sidebar.

showTasksTab.name: Show Tasks tab
showTasksTab.desc: Show the Tasks tab in the sidebar.

showCurrentFolderTab.name: Show Current Folder tab
showCurrentFolderTab.desc: Lists highlights from every note in the folder of the note you're viewing.

displayModes.heading: Display modes
displayModes.saveCurrentLabel: Save current settings as a display mode
displayModes.saveCurrentDesc: Create a new display mode from your current Display and Views settings. Saved modes can be applied from the Command Palette or using the Apply button below.
displayModes.noModes: No display modes saved yet. Create one to get started.
displayModes.updateTooltip: Update this mode with current settings

detailsTextSize.name: Details text size
detailsTextSize.desc: Adjust details text size (filename, line number, etc) (default 11).

highlightTextWeight.name: Highlight text weight
highlightTextWeight.desc: Adjust font weight for sidebar highlights (default Normal).

taskTextWeight.name: Task text weight
taskTextWeight.desc: Adjust font weight for sidebar tasks (default Normal).

colors.heading: Colors
colors.customizeFirst: Customize the first highlight color for the sidebar hover color picker.
colors.customizeSecond: Customize the second highlight color for the sidebar hover color picker.
colors.customizeThird: Customize the third highlight color for the sidebar hover color picker.
colors.customizeFourth: Customize the fourth highlight color for the sidebar hover color picker.
colors.customizeFifth: Customize the fifth highlight color for the sidebar hover color picker.

colorNames.heading: Color names
colorNames.desc: Optional: Add a custom name for this color to use in Group By Color instead of the hex code.

useInlineFootnotes.name: Use inline footnotes by default
useInlineFootnotes.desc: When adding comments via the sidebar, use inline footnotes (^[comment]) instead of standard footnotes ([^ref]: comment).

removeWithHighlight.name: Remove comments with highlight
removeWithHighlight.desc: When removing a highlight from the sidebar, also remove its comments and any footnote definitions left orphaned. Off by default, since comments can hold text you did not intend to delete.

selectTextOnClick.name: Select text on click
selectTextOnClick.desc: When clicking a comment, select the comment instead of positioning the cursor in front of it. Note: Only works for inline footnotes (^[...]) and standard footnotes ([^1]), not HTML comments or custom patterns.

enable.name: Enable AI features
enable.desc: Off by default. While this is off the plugin makes no network requests of any kind.

privacy.title: Before you add a key
privacy.storage: API keys are stored in plain text in the plugin's data.json, which syncs with your vault. Do not add one to a shared vault.
privacy.backups: AI settings are left out of the plugin's backups, so a backup file never carries a copy of your key.
privacy.scope: Text is sent only when you run a prompt, and only the text that prompt asks for. Nothing is sent in the background.

profile.name: Active profile
profile.desc: The provider used when you run a prompt. Add more than one to switch between services.
profile.empty: No profiles yet. Add one to choose a provider and a model.

provider.name: Provider
provider.desc: Picking a provider fills in its default URL and model, unless you have already changed them.

wireFormat.name: API format
wireFormat.desc: Which request shape the endpoint speaks. Most third-party endpoints are OpenAI compatible.

baseUrl.name: Base URL
baseUrl.desc: Include the version segment, exactly as the provider's documentation shows it.

apiKey.name: API key
apiKey.desc: Stored in plain text in the plugin's data.json.
apiKey.missing: This provider needs a key before it can be used.

model.name: Model
model.desc: Free text, so a model newer than this list still works.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.desc: Leave empty to use the provider's default. Some reasoning models reject this parameter entirely.

maxTokens.name: Max output tokens
maxTokens.desc: Leave empty to use the provider's default.

actions.name: Profile actions
actions.desc: Test sends one very short request to confirm the key, URL and model all line up.

timeout.name: Request timeout
timeout.desc: Seconds to wait before giving up on a response.

includeNote.name: Allow prompts to read the whole note
includeNote.desc: Off by default. While off, {{note}} and {{context}} resolve to nothing and only the highlight itself is sent.

includeComments.name: Allow prompts to read existing comments
includeComments.desc: Lets a template reference {{comments}}. Off by default.

charLimit.name: Context character limit
charLimit.desc: How much note text a single prompt may carry, at most.

targetLanguage.name: Default translation language
targetLanguage.desc: Used for {{targetLang}}. Leave empty to translate into the language Obsidian is displayed in.

confirm.name: Confirm before the first send
confirm.desc: Shows the destination and the payload size once per vault, before anything leaves your machine.

outputLanguage.name: Answer language
outputLanguage.desc: The language AI answers are written in. Translation prompts use the translation language below instead.

customOutputLanguage.name: Custom answer language
customOutputLanguage.desc: For example 简体中文, English or 日本語.

prompts.heading: Prompts
prompts.desc: What you can run on a highlight. Built-in prompts can be disabled or edited, never deleted — clearing your edits restores the original.
prompts.exported: Copied {{count}} prompt changes to the clipboard
prompts.exportEmpty: You have not changed any prompts yet, so there is nothing to copy.
prompts.exportFailed: Could not reach the clipboard. Copy the JSON from the developer console instead.
prompts.importDesc: Replaces your prompt changes with the pasted set. Built-in prompts you have not edited are unaffected.
prompts.importPlaceholder: Paste the JSON you copied from another vault
prompts.importInvalid: That is not a valid prompt list. Expected a JSON array of objects with an id.

rendering.heading: Comment rendering
rendering.desc: Applies to every comment in the sidebar, whether or not AI is switched on.

enable.name: Rich rendering
enable.desc: Render comments that contain code blocks, tables, lists or diagrams with Obsidian’s full markdown renderer. Off returns to plain inline formatting.

mermaid.name: Render mermaid diagrams
mermaid.desc: Draw mermaid code blocks as diagrams. A diagram that fails to parse falls back to its source.

maxHeight.name: Maximum diagram height
maxHeight.desc: Height in pixels before a diagram is cropped in the sidebar. Click the diagram to open it full screen.

streaming.name: Stream responses
streaming.desc: Show the answer as it is generated. Desktop only — mobile always waits for the full response, and a stream that cannot be established falls back to one automatically.
streaming.mobile: Not available on mobile; this device will always wait for the full response.

usage.heading: Usage this month
usage.desc: Counted locally and never transmitted. Prompts and answers are not recorded — only totals.

charLimit.name: Characters per whole-note request
charLimit.desc: Longer notes are split at headings or paragraphs and processed in several requests. A larger value uses fewer requests but requires a model with a larger context window.

extractColor.name: Color for extracted highlights
extractColor.desc: The color written into the note for a passage the model picked out, so you can tell them from your own at a glance and filter on it in the sidebar.
extractColor.cleared: Extracted passages will be written as plain ==text==
extractColor.plain: No color set: extracted passages are written as plain ==text==.

maxRetries.name: Maximum retries
maxRetries.desc: Retry transient failures automatically. Default: 2. Set to 0 to disable retries.

detectHtmlComments.name: Detect HTML comments
detectHtmlComments.desc: Detect HTML comments (<!-- -->) as highlights. Note: HTML comments are hidden in Live Preview mode and only visible in Source mode.

detectAdjacentNativeComments.name: Detect adjacent native comments
detectAdjacentNativeComments.desc: When enabled, native Obsidian comments (%% %%) that appear immediately after a highlight will be treated as comments for that highlight. When disabled, all native comments appear separately in the sidebar.

customPatterns.heading: Custom patterns
customPatterns.desc: Define custom highlight or comment patterns using regex. This allows detection of syntax from other plugins or custom formats.

excludeExcalidraw.name: Exclude Excalidraw files
excludeExcalidraw.desc: Skip .excalidraw files when scanning for highlights. This prevents highlights from being detected in Excalidraw drawing files.

excludedFiles.name: File filters
excludedFiles.desc: Include or exclude specific files and folders from being scanned for highlights and tasks.

showTaskContext.name: Show task notes
showTaskContext.desc: Tasks containing bulleted text will display as notes under the task.

hideTasksPluginMetadata.name: Hide Tasks plugin metadata
hideTasksPluginMetadata.desc: Hide scheduling metadata added by the Tasks plugin (due and scheduled dates, recurrence, priority) from task text in the sidebar. Your notes are not changed.

showCompletedTasks.name: Show completed tasks
showCompletedTasks.desc: Include completed and cancelled tasks (- [x], - [-]) in the Tasks tab.

showCurrentNoteSection.name: Show current note tasks
showCurrentNoteSection.desc: Display a dedicated section at the top of the Tasks tab showing tasks from the currently active note.

showOnlyCurrentNoteTasks.name: Only display current note tasks
showOnlyCurrentNoteTasks.desc: When enabled, hide all other tasks and only show tasks from the current note.

taskDateFormat.name: Due date format
taskDateFormat.desc: Date format for parsing due dates in tasks (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD, MM/DD/YYYY). Due dates matching this format will be displayed as badges.

backupRestore.heading: Backup and restore

restoreLatest.name: Restore from backup
restoreLatest.desc: Restore collections that contain highlights from a backup. Sidebar Highlights automatically creates periodic backups. Highlights in Collections that no longer exist in your vault will not be restored.

createManual.name: Create backup
createManual.desc: Create a backup of your collections.

maxBackups.name: Automatic backups to keep
maxBackups.desc: How many automatic backups to retain. When the limit is exceeded, the oldest automatic backups are removed. Manual backups are never deleted.

backupRestore.noBackups: No backups found. Backups are created automatically when settings are migrated or when external changes are detected.
backupRestore.emptyBackup: The latest backup does not contain any collections.
backupRestore.confirmRestore:
Restore {{collections}} collection(s) (containing {{highlights}} highlight(s)) from backup created at {{date}}?

This will replace your current collections.
backupRestore.restoreFailed: Failed to restore from backup. Please check the console for details.
backupRestore.manualBackupSkipped: Backup skipped. Your most recent backup is already identical.

excalidrawFolder.name: Excalidraw mindmap folder
excalidrawFolder.desc: Where exported mindmaps are saved. Leave empty to save each mindmap next to the note it came from.

excalidrawComments.name: Include comments in mindmaps
excalidrawComments.desc: Draw each comment as a child node of the highlight it belongs to. Turn off for a map of highlights alone.

excalidrawAutoSync.name: Refresh mindmaps automatically
excalidrawAutoSync.desc: Redraw a note's mindmap whenever its highlights or comments change. Only applies to notes that already have one. A refresh replaces the drawing, so anything arranged or added inside it by hand is lost.

excalidrawOpenBeside.name: Open mindmaps beside the note
excalidrawOpenBeside.desc: Open a mindmap in a split pane next to the note it came from, so the two can be read together. Turn off to open it in a new tab instead.

readiness.noProfile: No AI profile yet. Add one in Settings, under AI.
readiness.noBaseUrl: This profile has no base URL.
readiness.noModel: This profile has no model name.
readiness.noApiKey: This profile has no API key.

errors.quota: The provider reports no remaining quota.
errors.network: Could not reach the provider. Check your connection and the base URL.
errors.server: The provider hit an internal error.

run.fileMissing: That note is no longer in the vault.
run.emptyAnswer: The model returned nothing to insert.
run.writeFailed: Could not write to the note.
run.highlightMoved: The highlight has changed since the sidebar last read it, so there is nowhere safe to attach the comment. Refresh the sidebar and try again.

batch.empty: No highlights to run this on
batch.writeFailed: The comment could not be written

note.chunked: This long note will be processed in {{count}} parts so no source content is omitted.
note.markedSome: Highlighted {{marked}} passages. {{missed}} could not be found in the note word for word and were skipped.
note.markedNone: None of the {{total}} passages matched the note word for word, so nothing was highlighted. The model paraphrased instead of quoting — try again, or ask it to quote exactly.
note.noPassages: The model returned no passages to highlight.

image.notFound: Image not found in the vault: {{name}}
image.unsupported: This image format cannot be sent to the model: {{name}}

toolbar.exportExcalidraw: Export visible highlights to Excalidraw mindmap ({{count}})

emptyStates.noMatchingAcrossAll: No matching highlights across all files.
emptyStates.noHighlightsAcrossAll: No highlights found across all files.
emptyStates.noMatchingTasks: No matching tasks across all files.
emptyStates.noTasksAcrossAll: No tasks found across all files.

collection.descDesc: Provide more context about the collection (Optional)

excludedFiles.title: File filters
excludedFiles.noFilter: No file filters are applied. Add one below.
excludedFiles.currentlyExcluded: Files matching the following filters are currently excluded:
excludedFiles.currentlyIncluded: Files matching the following filters are currently included:
excludedFiles.alreadyExists: {{path}} is already in the filter list

customPattern.nameDesc: A descriptive name for this pattern (e.g., "Regex Mark", "IA Writer comments")
customPattern.patternDesc: Regex pattern with a capturing group for the content. Examples:
customPattern.typeDesc: Whether to treat matches as highlights or comments
customPattern.nameRequired: Please enter a name for the pattern
customPattern.capturingGroupRequired: Pattern must include a capturing group, e.g., //(.+)//
customPattern.conflictWarning: Warning: Pattern may conflict with built-in {{name}}. This could cause unexpected behavior.

displayMode.nameDesc: A descriptive name for this display configuration
displayMode.nameRequired: Please enter a name for the display mode

aiPrompt.builtinNotice: This is a built-in prompt. Your edits are kept as a patch, so anything you leave alone keeps improving with the plugin.
aiPrompt.iconDesc: A Lucide icon name, e.g. sparkles.
aiPrompt.templateDesc: The message sent to the model. Click a variable below to insert it.
aiPrompt.unknownVariable: Not a variable: {{names}}. It will be sent as written.
aiPrompt.scopeDesc: A highlight prompt is offered on a card and in the editor. A whole-note prompt is offered on the sidebar toolbar and reads the whole document.
aiPrompt.outOfScopeVariable: {{names}} is not available to this scope and will resolve to nothing.
aiPrompt.noPrimaryVariable: A template that never references {{name}} will not see what it is meant to be about.

aiConfirm.title: Send to the model?
aiConfirm.lead: Nothing has been sent yet. This is what will leave your machine.
aiConfirm.manyRequests: A note this long is sent in several requests and costs several times what one does, so it is confirmed even though per-send confirmation is off.
aiConfirm.dontAsk: Don't ask again for this vault

aiResult.unknownVariable: This template references {{names}}, which is not a variable. It was sent as written.

notices.commentNeedsEditor: Could not open that note in an editor to add the comment.
notices.excalidrawExportFailed: Could not create the Excalidraw file: {{reason}}
notices.excalidrawNotAMindmap: This file is not a mindmap exported by Sidebar Highlights
notices.noImageAtCursor: Place the cursor on an image embed first.

aiResult.title: AI result
